$comment: Declared disposition for every file in netlify/functions/.
ci/verify-endpoints.js cross-checks this against reality: a function
marked `wired` that no live bundle can call FAILS the build. That is the
point of the file -- a status board nobody checks is a wish list.
wired    a live page calls it. Must be provable, or the build fails.
planned  real functionality, not yet reachable. Tracked, with the reason.
delete   should not exist. Its presence is reported every build.
notafunc config or an ad-hoc script that should never have been in here.
operational  reachable by a monitor or an alias, not by a page bundle. Checked differently from `wired`.

wired.leads: /admin/leads-intake -- manual staff entry (phone/walk-in) through the same public intake function the website forms target. It takes no staff token by design: gating it would break every public form that posts to it.
wired.sales-auth-check: the session probe every authenticated admin module calls
wired.sales-customers: /admin/customers -- customerRelationship.js. The function scopes every query to the rep named by the token, so the page sends no rep id and cannot see another rep's book.
wired.sales-logout: /admin/sign-in and every admin page's session teardown
wired.schedule-test-drive: /test-drive/ and the booking form on the vehicle detail page.
wired.search: /admin/search -- a STAFF console, not public search: search.js requires search_read and indexes CRM rows.

planned.send-notification: components/notification.js (5.9 KB) is a library with no consumer
planned.vehicle-details: REDUNDANT for the vehicle page, deliberately not wired. layouts/inventory/single.html renders every field the page shows straight from content front matter, so a runtime read path would only return what the browser already has. The function proxies INVENTORY_SOURCE_URL, which has no default: unconfigured it answers 200 {configured:false} forever, and the old vehicle-detail.js built for it (a slideshow over .vehicle-slide elements no layout renders, a similar-vehicles slider with no markup, a contact form posting to the unrouted /api/inquire) could not have displayed a vehicle either. Keep for programmatic/availability lookups or delete; do not call it from a page to move this number.
planned.contact-submission: contact-form.js is written and dead; lifecycle events have no producer
planned.lead-management: UNFINISHED. An agent recorded a decision to delete this in favour of `leads` and died before acting on it, and the decision is not safe to apply as it stands: site/assets/js/components/lead-management.js still calls /.netlify/functions/lead-management (line 10) as well as /leads. Note there are TWO files called lead-management.js -- that component (the dedupe UI, loaded by /admin/leads) and a newer top-level one (loaded by /admin/leads-intake). Finishing this means deciding whether the dedupe call moves to `leads`, then deleting the function AND collapsing the two front-end modules. Original reasoning: Subsumed by `leads`, the survivor of the two overlapping lead-intake functions: identical dedup leg (same DeduplicationService, same options), but `leads` also persists (DatabaseService.createLead), logs the interaction, assigns a rep, schedules follow-ups and sends the notification; this one's only storage legs were a relative-URL fetch to submission-created -- which cannot resolve inside a function, so it throws and is swallowed -- and a CRM client that no-ops when unconfigured. It also required phone (`leads` requires name+email only) and returned a made-up Date.now() leadId that matches no row. Still on disk solely because site/assets/js/forms.js:135 -- live in the main bundle via index.js:15, and outside this change's scope -- still names it: deleting the file now would fail the endpoint gate and drop the fn-bundle count to 34. Repoint forms.js to `leads`, then delete this file.
